entities.name: Baš Čelik
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Baš Čelik, meaning "head of steel", from Turkish baş for "head" and çelik for "steel", is a Serbian fairy tale, collected by Vuk Karadžić. It is similar to the Brothers Grimm's "The Crystal Orb".
